zones.label: Notice Pressure
zones.summary: Pressure may use urgency, guilt, threats, flattery, secrecy, or repeated requests.
facts: Discomfort is enough reason to pause.
Manipulation is the responsibility of the person using it.

zones.label: State a Boundary
zones.summary: Use a clear statement such as no, stop, or I am not sharing that.
facts: You do not owe a long explanation.
Leave the conversation when it is safer to do so.

zones.label: Save Evidence
zones.summary: Preserve relevant messages, usernames, dates, or screenshots when safe.
facts: Do not forward harmful or private content to peers.
A trusted adult can help preserve evidence appropriately.

zones.label: Block or Report
zones.summary: Use platform, school, or device controls to reduce contact and report abuse.
facts: Blocking is a safety tool, not rudeness.
A report may need follow-up through another channel.

zones.label: Get Support
zones.summary: Tell a trusted adult, school professional, caregiver, or appropriate authority.
facts: Immediate threats or exploitation require urgent help.
